summary: Read the auth, session, CSRF, RBAC, router, body, static, audit, services and publish code and probed a live seeded instance with a recorded script (cross-team IDOR on every incident/draft/statement/postmortem route, RBAC by role, CSRF/Origin, SQLi, body limits, traversal, limiter, fixation/logout) plus a full npm test run after the submission. No demonstrable blocking issue; low and info notes only.

criteria.description: Authentication: scrypt with bounded stored params and dummy hash for unknown/disabled users, random 256-bit session ids stored hashed, rotation on login, server-side invalidation on logout, HttpOnly SameSite=Strict cookies
CSRF/Origin: mutating requests need matching header and cookie bound to the session (or an HMAC pre-login token only on unauthenticated routes); foreign Origin refused
Login limiter bounded and effective (429 after 5 failures, correct password still refused while locked, case-variant username shares the key)
RBAC default-deny: routes without an action cannot be registered, unknown actions are denied, viewer/responder limits enforced, only leads publish and manage users/audit; unauthenticated gets 401

IDOR/team scoping: a Payments lead gets 404 on every Platform incident, notes, draft, statement edit/delete, publish and postmortem route; user list and audit are team-scoped; teamId in the body is rejected

Injection and input limits: all SQL parameterised, SQLi strings in login/audit query rejected with 400, 2 MB body gets 413, wrong content type 415, malformed JSON 400, __proto__ body 400, strict integer path params
Error leakage and logs: fixed envelope messages, no stack/SQL/path in 4xx/5xx, request log contains no passwords, cookies or tokens, audit detail holds hashes/lengths not text
Publish re-verifies server-side inside BEGIN IMMEDIATE and refuses ungrounded drafts regardless of stored status; refusal is audited
Static server: encoded, double-encoded, backslash, NUL, dotfile and source-path traversal attempts all return 404; extension whitelist plus realpath containment
Provider wiring: index.js passes no providers so the registry builds anthropic/cli/fallback from config; fake providers only with GW_ENABLE_FAKE=1; API URL must be https unless loopback
Full test suite passes after the submission

findings.title: Session and CSRF cookies are not Secure by default
findings.detail: GW_COOKIE_SECURE defaults to false (probe showed no Secure attribute). Acceptable on loopback; over TLS deployments an operator who forgets the flag leaks the session cookie on any plain HTTP request.
findings.recommendation: Document it in the README run section, or log a startup warning when HOST is not loopback and the flag is off.

findings.title: Username uniqueness is global, so a team lead can learn that a username exists in another team
findings.detail: POST /api/users with 'payments-lead' from a Platform lead returned 409 USERNAME_TAKEN. Lead-only and the names are not secret in this product, so impact is small.
findings.recommendation: Accept and document, or scope usernames per team.

findings.title: Login limiter key is username|ip only
findings.detail: One IP can try many usernames, each with 5 attempts per 15 min, bounded only by scrypt cost. Behind a reverse proxy all clients share one IP key. State is in memory and resets on restart (documented).
findings.recommendation: Consider an additional per-IP failure ceiling later.

findings.title: Only some denials are audited; static serving of real files not probed live
findings.detail: Audit-on-deny covers publish, users and audit (disclosed in the submission). public/ does not exist yet, so positive static serving and symlink escape were not probed live; the code (extension whitelist, realpath containment) and test/api/static.test.js cover them. Re-check at the UI phase.
findings.recommendation: Re-review static serving once public/ lands.
